text.en: Oh — you're here! Hi hi, {name}! I've been waiting for you.
text.zh-CN: 哦——你来啦！嗨嗨，{name}！我一直在等你呢。

text.en: Welcome to Catopia — our little island, floating all on its own in a big quiet sea.
text.zh-CN: 欢迎来到 Catopia——我们的小岛，独自漂在一片安静的大海上。

text.en: I'm Cato, the little spirit of this place. I look after the island... and you look after me. Partners!
text.zh-CN: 我是 Cato，这座岛的小精灵。我照看着岛……你照看着我。我们是搭档啦！

text.en: Let me show you the tools real quick — it'll only take a moment.
text.zh-CN: 我很快带你认识一下工具吧——一小会儿就好。

text.en: This is the hoe. Pick it, then tap the grass to till a patch of soil — that's where seeds go.
text.zh-CN: 这是锄头。选中它，点草地就能锄出一块地——种子就种在锄好的地上。

text.en: The watering can keeps the soil wet. Watered crops grow much faster — so give them a drink!
text.zh-CN: 水壶用来浇地。浇过水的作物长得快多了——记得给它们喝水哦！

text.en: These are seed bags. Pick one, then tap tilled soil to plant it. When it's ripe, tap to harvest!
text.zh-CN: 这些是种子袋。选一个，点锄好的地就能种下。长熟了，点一下就能收获！

text.en: There's more out in the wild — an axe for trees, a pickaxe for stones — but let's save those for later.
text.zh-CN: 野外还有更多——砍树的斧头、敲石头的镐子——不过那些以后再说啦。

text.en: Oh — and if you ever get busy, just tap me and ask! I love lending a paw.
text.zh-CN: 对了——你要是忙不过来，点我一下说一声就行！我最爱帮忙啦。

text.en: Okay! Let's make this little island bloom together, {name}.
text.zh-CN: 好啦！我们一起让这座小岛热闹起来吧，{name}。
